newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp launches $5.0 bln Euro notes.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp launches $5.0 bln Euro notes.

text.p: KeyCorp said it has launched a $5.0 billion medium-term note program for European investors.
KeyCorp said the program provides for the sale, from time to time, of notes with maturities of 30 days to 30 years from the date of original issue.
Notes may be either senior or subordinated and can be denominated in a number of different currencies, KeyCorp said.
Keycorp said the notes, which will not be registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, will be offered exclusively to non-U.S. investors.

Proceeds from sale of the notes will be used for general corporate purposes, including reductions in short-term borrowings, redemption of bank notes, funding of anticipated asset growth, investments, and financing possible future acquisitions.
The program has been arranged by J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd, KeyCorp said.
